summary.intent: Continue orchestrating CipherBox phase 69 (fuse/WinFsp node/v3 migration) by executing plan 69-20, which migrates vault-creation from legacy FolderMetadata to an empty node/v3 root, then merge it into the phase branch.
summary.outcome: Plan 69-20 was implemented in an isolated worktree, verified green (cargo check, KAT unit test, core/fuse test suites), merged as 53aed18c7 with no scope deviations, bringing phase 69 to 18/20 merged plans.

repo: Vault creation should build the empty root via build_empty_root_published_node, composing the core seal path directly (Node::Root + NodeWriteBody -> seal_published_node -> encode_published_node) rather than build_folder_emission/create_folder_node, since those mint random keys unsuitable for the root.
The v2 vault-KEY-blob path (serialize_vault_blob_v2 + ecies::wrap_key) and /vault/init tail are intentionally untouched during node/v3 migrations — ECIES is retained per requirement NODE-06.

Root key derivation must byte-match the mount bridge in fuse/mod.rs:192-205: root_read_key = root_folder_key[..32], root_write_key = root_read_key ^ 0xA5, via the existing derive_vault_ipns_keypair HKDF.

code.finding: Mount-side derivation of root_read_key/root_write_key from root_folder_key that vault-creation's new empty-root path must byte-match exactly for a freshly created vault to mount correctly.

workflow: Plans are executed by background worktree agents (branch worktree-agent-<id>) and reported via task-notification; the orchestrator then runs a separate verify+merge step before tracking/pruning and moving to the next plan.
Green boundary for this phase is defined as: cargo check --workspace clean, relevant KAT/unit tests passing, and a grep confirming no residual references to the legacy type/functions being removed.

open_items: 69-10 (deletion of legacy FolderMetadata-related types) is now unblocked since 69-20 removed the last live consumer in vault.rs — next plan to execute.
69-14/WinFsp remains blocked on the user's Windows box.
Root IPNS/read/write key derivation for node/v3 is a placeholder (phase-63 coupling) until real root-key persistence/recovery is implemented.
Live vault create-then-mount round-trip is unverified in this plan; deferred/accepted (D-06) pending phase-63 desktop-e2e coverage.
